notes: #1: Commons dates the plate 1597 (vol. 5); dated 1598 per the volume’s first publication, change to 1597 if that date is on the plate. #2, titled Rostochium (1572), actually shows Wismar (Braun and Hogenberg swapped the names); #3, titled Wismaria, is Rostock but only 1010 px wide, so not used. #4 is the same vol. 5 plate as #1 in a bound book with the gutter through it. #14 is the same Kersting painting as #11, lower resolution. P3 could also take Tischbein 1843 (#13) instead, but it is only 34 years after 1809. #22 (Erich Möller) is dated only “before 1942”. #23 has a thin dark line across the negative and some haze. #19–#21 show Warnemünde, not the city.
